# noqeri/openai v0.5.0

Retains all 0.4.0 exports and adds 28 existing, substantially deeper MIT-licensed 0.1.1 Noqeri functions (notice in LICENSE-MIT). Expanded endpoints, validation, retry/status helpers and request capabilities. `providerHttpJson`/ `providerHttpStatus` still need a trusted host and valid scoped credentials; the package alone is not an HTTP transport. No Node.js runtime required. Source compatibility and live-API tests have not been run.
